scripts.dev: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @seyyon/api" "npm run dev -w @seyyon/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run dev -w @seyyon/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run dev -w @seyyon/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run build -w @seyyon/api && npm run build -w @seyyon/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run test -w @seyyon/api
scripts.test:module3:api: npm run build -w @seyyon/shared && npm run test:organization -w @seyyon/api && npm run test:employees -w @seyyon/api
